description: The manifest of the worked example declares the extension ext-01-database (the files of spec/extensions/ are copied beside it). With this delta and the two files the example reports what the plain example reports.

value.rationale: The identity service keeps reset tokens and member credentials in a relational store. Its datastores, tables and validation rules are three dedicated sections that the core steps 05 to 07 cannot express.

value.title: Database Extension
value.justification: The password reset requirement needs a stored, single-use token and the identity service owns that storage; no core step describes a table.
value.schema_design_guidelines: Reuse vc:core:atoms#kebabId for datastore and table ids (ds-{name}, tbl-{name}). Every table names its datastore and the requirement it exists for. Include validation_rules that a test can verify; avoid engine-specific options.
